name: Tuner
description: Tune your guitar, bass, ukulele or violin with the microphone: a needle shows how far you are, and it turns green when it's right.
prompt: A chromatic and instrument tuner using the microphone with pitch detection, a needle in cents, the nearest string for guitar, bass, ukulele and violin, tune up or down hints, reference A from 415 to 466 Hz and tappable strings that play the target note.
author: gonzaroman
